notes.title: December Update to be released on Steam: Sunday Dec 10th
notes.notes:
Corrects an issue that could block a second controller from being recognized in 2 player games.
Now reloads all plays each time the game enters into the stadium, this prevents the need to restart the game completely after creating new plays from scratch.


As well, a complete breakdown of what the plan is for 2018 will be made public in the next few weeks!

notes.title: Details of the November update
notes.notes:
Here are the fixes in the latest update on Steam

 We've corrected the issue of the Man 2 Man coverage dialog loading empty in the Play Designer.
 Corrected the problem of offensive linemen "jittering" while dropping back from the line of scrimage during pass blocking. The pass blocking movement is much smoother now.
 Corrected the issue of Right Guards not picking up the correct player when the defense is running a play with 5 down linemen.
 Improved the back field blocking assignment logic.
 Corrected an issue with kick returners 'warping into position should the ball bounce before they can field the kick.
 Corrected the issue of playoff games that are still tied at the end of Over Time not continuing until there's a winner.
 Corrected an issue of Defensive Backs on human controlled teams occasionally breaking off task after pass is thrown and ending up out of position.

Side note: the Xbox1 update is passed certification and should be available for players to download today as well.  It has all the major functionality of 1.5.5.0 as well as the fixes listed above.

notes.title: MOD goodies included with patch v1.5.5.0
notes.notes:
Canuckplay has included League Templates & a Roster Maker.

After the new patch has been downloaded, there are two new folders in the game installation folder.  (usually "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Canadian Football 2017"):

\TeamTemplates
\RosterMaker\RosterMaker\bin\Debug\RosterMaker.exe

The templates are for 10, 16 and 32 team leagues.

The RosterMaker even includes the C# source code should you wish to create your own roster editing utility using Visual Studio 2017.

Details can be found at http://canuckplay.blogspot.ca/2017/10/league-templates-roster-maker.html

Looking forward to what all you creative folks can come up with!

notes.title: Get ready! Major patch coming to Steam on Monday, October 30th!
notes.notes:
As we've said, this is more than a patch, this is some major functionality.

The Big Two:

[olist]
Season Mode: which has been asked for since day 1.
Hybrid American Rules: which has been asked for by many people who want to play around with American rules on a Canadian size field.
[/olist]

Join the discussion board and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Canadian Football Oct '17 Patch News
notes.notes:
Canadian Football v 1.5.5.0 is soon to be released to Steam.  It will include:

Quick Season Mode.
Practice Mode.
Support Full Canadian Pro and Hybrid US Rule sets.
Updated UI.
Various in-game tweaks and adjustments.

More details to follow.
